text:
tara lim: starting quickpack for customer Zeppelin LoRA v1.1 — focus on token stability (SKU#/ #INV) and currency placement. running int4 smoke.

tara lim: cmd: `./mk_quickpack --base pegasus-13b --lora zepp_v1_1.safetensors --quant int4 --checks token_stability,currency_format --out /artifacts/zepp_qp_1754328000`

oscar v: include 'ambiguous-hash' set (cases: ' #INV', '#INV', '##INV', 'SKU#123') and euro/currency edgecases.

mira sood: remember Zeppelin used custom bytepair mapping for 'SKU#' and 'CUR€'. if those get aliased we'll break downstream parsers.

token-bot: run queued on p-qe-gpu-02 (job 8821). ETA ~3m.

eval-bot: run started (id qp-1754328000). streaming logs -> /artifacts/zepp_qp_1754328000/log.txt

tara lim: first pass: 4/9 checks failed. top issues: (1) '#INV' emitted as '# INV' (space inserted), (2) 'SKU#' output lost trailing '#', (3) currency placed before amount for euro in some templates (got '€ 1.234,50' vs expected '1.234,50 €'), (4) thousands separator inconsistent. sample: `expected: "#INV-42" got: "# INV-42"`

oscar v: space insertion looks like token split plus postproc glue bug. could be our tokenizer returned separate tokens '#' and 'INV' and postproc inserted a space between them.

mira sood: check merge logs for token alias warnings. also check postproc normalizer rules — we recently tweaked join rules for punctuation which might add spaces when tokens are separate.

token-bot: merge log excerpt: `WARN token_alias: 'SKU#' id 62400 collides -> aliased to seq ['SKU', '#']`

oscar v: plan: (a) create vocab_lock.json to pin 'SKU#' and '#INV' to customer's original ids; (b) re-run merge with `--vocab-lock`; (c) run postproc unit that treats protected_tokens as atomic (no join-space).

tara lim: applying patch: vocab_lock.json -> {"#INV":"62410","SKU#":"62400","CUR€":"60299"}. re-run with conservative prune and bankers rounding.

ci-bot: note: CI will run extra token-stability gate on PR if included.

eval-bot: re-run done (id qp-1754328360). results: 8/9 pass. token spacing fixed, SKU# preserved, euro placement normalized. remaining failure: tiny ROUGE drop on long-paraphrase set (-0.6). artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/zepp/v1_1/1754328360/report.html and /artifacts/zepp_qp_1754328000/token_diff.json

mira sood: ROUGE drift expected under int4; recommend mixed-KV int8 canary for production. also +1 on adding the token-stability check to merge-tool CI so future merges fail fast.

oscar v: I'll open PR with the vocab-lock helpers + CI gate and a small unit that asserts no protected token was split after merge. linking PR when ready.

tara lim: thanks. I'll update AE with artifacts and schedule the mixed-KV canary next week. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
